title: Maximize the Reservoir
statement:
You are given an array of N non-negative integers representing the heights of vertical lines drawn on a plane. The distance between adjacent lines is 1 unit.

Find two lines that, together with the x-axis, form a container that holds the most water. Return the maximum amount of water the container can store.
input_format:
The first line contains a single integer N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers representing the heights.
output_format: Print a single integer: the maximum area of water the container can hold.
